column2: This sheet shows the CO2_T_COM FYBE pipeline transport cost and performance outputs for every potential CO2 mass flow rate and capacity factor combination possible based on user inputs, at 10 mile intervals from 10 to 1000 miles, using the Brown et al. (2022) capital cost equations for the Great Lakes region (which is a proxy for the national average).  The cost data in this sheet is used to calculate transports costs in the 'Transport Dist Calculator' sheet.
